sanskrit_verse: दीर्घकुत्सितरोगार्ता व्यङ्गा संसृष्टमैथुना । धृष्टान्यगतभावा च कन्यादोषाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
transliteration: dīrghakutsitarogārtā vyaṅgā saṃsṛṣṭamaithunā | dhṛṣṭānyagatabhāvā ca kanyādoṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: A girl afflicted with chronic repugnant disease, physically impaired, defiled through intercourse, or whose consciousness is corrupted and misaligned—these are declared as conditions that vitiate the foundation of maidenhood.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority stems from purity and alignment of consciousness, not biological status
Causation arises from violation of svadharma, not social judgment
Capacity-based responsibility requires intact consciousness and self-sovereignty
Restoration logic demands purification and realignment of violated consciousness
Consciousness alignment supersedes physical or social definitions of worth
executable_legal_axioms: IF a female's consciousness is violated through non-consensual union THEN initiate purification and restoration protocols
IF chronic illness disrupts svadharma THEN assign capacity-adjusted roles until restoration
IF physical deformity results from external harm THEN activate causal accountability in perpetrator consciousness
IF consciousness shows signs of misalignment THEN deploy nyaya-based reintegration procedures
IF societal defamation occurs without dharma violation THEN nullify causal attribution
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies in identifying whether consciousness was violated or misaligned. Physical or social impairments alone do not constitute legal fault unless tied to conscious violation. Authority is determined by alignment with dharma, not social norms.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that misalignment arises from disrupted consciousness, not inherent defect. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces causality to the original violation. Responsibility is proportional to awareness and intent. The non-punitive reality rule mandates restoration of integrity, not infliction of suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate purification rituals to restore consciousness integrity
Assign mentorship to rebuild svadharma alignment
Deploy community reintegration processes based on demonstrated consciousness correction
Establish completion processes for causal agents to dissolve karmic residue
Activate self-sovereignty protocols to restore individual agency
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored through consciousness realignment. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
